spec.title: Service Overview v1
spec.description: HTTP service metrics, infrastructure utilization, and log signals.

spec.name: metrics_datasource
spec.label: Metrics
spec.description: Select a datasource to use for metrics queries.

spec.name: logs_datasource
spec.label: Logs
spec.description: Select a datasource to use for logs queries.

spec.name: service
spec.label: Service
spec.description: Filter metrics/logs to a specific service name.

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: Total HTTP requests per second across all selected services.

spec.title: Error Rate
spec.description: Percentage of HTTP requests returning 5xx status codes.

spec.title: Active Requests
spec.description: Current number of in-flight HTTP requests (gauge).

spec.title: P99 Latency
spec.description: 99th percentile request duration across all selected services.

spec.title: Request Rate by Status Code
spec.description: HTTP requests per second, split by response status code. Useful for spotting error surges.

spec.title: Request Rate by Route
spec.description: HTTP requests per second, split by method and route template. Identifies hottest endpoints.

spec.title: Request Latency Percentiles
spec.description: p50 / p95 / p99 request duration. Divergence between p95 and p99 indicates tail latency issues.

spec.title: Active Requests Over Time
spec.description: In-flight request count per route. Spikes here indicate slow upstream dependencies or long-running handlers.

spec.title: CPU Utilization
spec.description: Host CPU utilization ratio (0-1). Derived from the node:cpu_utilization:ratio_avg recording rule. Alert threshold: 80%.

spec.title: Memory Utilization
spec.description: Host memory utilization ratio (0-1). Derived from the node:memory_utilization:ratio recording rule. Alert threshold: 80%.

spec.title: Disk Utilization
spec.description:
Filesystem utilization ratio per mount point (0-1). Derived from the node:filesystem_utilization:ratio recording rule.
Excludes tmpfs, overlay, and other virtual filesystems.
Alert thresholds: warning 80%, critical 90%.

spec.title: Log Line Rate by Level
spec.description:
Log lines per second per service and level. Sourced from the service:log_lines:rate2m recording rule written to Mimir by Loki's ruler.
A rising error/fatal band warrants investigation.

spec.title: Log Error Ratio
spec.description:
Ratio of error/critical/fatal log lines to total log lines per service. Sourced from the service:log_error_ratio:rate2m recording rule.
Alert thresholds: warning 5%, critical 10%.

spec.title: Recent Logs
spec.description: Live log tail from Loki for selected services. Use the Explore link (top-right) to run ad-hoc LogQL queries.
